description: This file defines an API utility module for making HTTP requests with methods for GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE, handling authentication tokens, error handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Main function that creates and returns an object with HTTP methods (get, post, patch, put, delete) for API calls, managing tokens and error handling.
